change: right turns on red after a full stop (except on the island of Montréal), for the driven car and traffic, with an audit and a challenge; left turns at a signal wait for an oncoming car pulling away from its line, allow for oncoming vehicles speeding up, and no longer take a pull-out's left indicator for a left turn

method.kitsilano: 12 routes in dry, fog, rain and snow

right_on_red_v8.note: Counted in separate V8 runs of the same suites (after only): red lights reached where the route turns right, right turns made on red, and those where, after the full stop, the car waited because it could not see far enough to its left
